sections.section_heading: What is this Shopify workshop about?
sections.description:
This is a short, intensive workshop rather than a long course, designed for people who want a working online store (and the skill of building one) without spending months learning it.

Over five days you'll go from a blank Shopify account to a functioning store: products listed, payments connected, and a theme customized to look the part. Each day builds directly on the previous one.

It's practical by design. You'll be working inside an actual Shopify store throughout the workshop, not just watching a demo. This is a standalone workshop, with no prerequisite course and no coding background needed.

sections.section_heading: What will you learn in 5 days?
paragraphs: The curriculum

content.text: The curriculum
What will you learn in 5 days?
Day 1–2: Store Setup
Setting up a Shopify account and store structure
Choosing and configuring a theme
Store settings, domains and basic navigation
Understanding the Shopify admin dashboard
Day 3: Products & Listings
Adding products, variants and collections
Writing product listings that convert
Product images and basic SEO for listings
Organizing inventory and categories
Day 4: Payments & Checkout
Setting up payment gateways for India (Razorpay, UPI and cards)
Configuring shipping and tax settings
Understanding the checkout flow
Order management basics
Day 5: Customization & Launch
Basic theme customization (no-code)
Adding apps for common store needs
Pre-launch checklist
Where to go next: marketing basics, and finding your first freelance clients

content.text: A little more clarity
Good questions.
What is the fee for the Shopify workshop?+
The workshop fee is affordable and student-friendly, and it's a 5-day commitment rather than months. Contact us and we'll share the current fee upfront, with no hidden costs.
How do I become a Shopify expert or developer?+

Start by mastering store setup: structure, products, payments, themes and apps, which is what this workshop covers and what most paying clients need first. Build 2–3 portfolio stores, start freelancing, then add advanced skills like Liquid theme coding as your clients demand them.
Will I get a certificate?+
Yes, a certificate of completion from Ladder7 Nextstep Solutions, plus something more persuasive to clients: a live store you built that they can click through.
Can I start a dropshipping business after this workshop?+

The workshop teaches you the store side of dropshipping: building the storefront, listings, payments and checkout. Product sourcing and supplier logistics are business decisions beyond the workshop's scope, but you'll leave with the storefront skills every dropshipping model depends on.
Do I need coding skills or prior experience?+
No. Shopify is a no-code platform and the workshop assumes zero technical background. If you can use a web browser confidently, you can do this.
How do I start a Shopify store in India? Is it worth it?+

You need a Shopify subscription, an Indian payment gateway (like Razorpay), and products to sell; the workshop walks through the entire setup live, including India-specific payment, shipping and tax settings that generic YouTube tutorials skip.
Is this workshop online or offline?+
Hybrid sessions in Trivandrum. Either way it is live and hands-on; you build your store during the sessions, not after them.
Should I choose this or a full development course?+

Choose this workshop if you want a fast, practical e-commerce skill or a freelancing starting point. If you want to build web applications from scratch, our Full Stack Developer Course (MERN) is the deeper path. The free Career Goal session can help you decide.
